The '''70th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''' honoring the best in [[film]] and [[television]] of 2012, was broadcast live from the [[Beverly Hilton Hotel]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]] on January 13, 2013, by [[NBC]]. [[Tina Fey]] and [[Amy Poehler]] co-hosted. Nominations were announced on December 13 by [[Jessica Alba]], [[Megan Fox]] and [[Ed Helms]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/news/datablog/2012/dec/13/awards-season-2012-13-nominees-winners|title=Awards season 2012–13: the Golden Globe nominees|date=13 December 2012|work=Guardian UK|access-date=14 December 2012|archive-date=August 3, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170803013845/https://www.theguardian.com/news/datablog/2012/dec/13/awards-season-2012-13-nominees-winners|url-status=live}}</ref> The [[Golden Globe Cecil B. DeMille Award|Cecil B. DeMille Award]], honoring the lifetime achievements of actors and filmmakers, was announced on November 1, 2012, with [[Jodie Foster]] being the latest recipient of that trophy.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/blog/2012/08/70th-golden-globes-timeline-annouced/|title=70th Golden Globes Timeline Announced|date=August 21, 2012|work=goldenglobes.org|access-date=October 15, 2012|archive-date=August 23, 2012|archive-url=https://archive.today/20120823221517/http://www.goldenglobes.org/blog/2012/08/70th-golden-globes-timeline-annouced/|url-status=dead}}</ref> The ceremony was produced by [[Dick Clark Productions]] in association with the [[Hollywood Foreign Press Association]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/tv-and-radio/2013/jan/14/damian-lewis-maggie-smith-golden-globes|title=Damian Lewis and Maggie Smith win at the Golden Globes 2013|date=14 January
